item: Streaming body cap in the shared stats getter (R496)
summary: The shared stats getter (GISTEMP, OWID) now streams the body and refuses as soon as the byte count passes a bound derived from the data's own shape (or the declared Content-Length is already over it), instead of after the whole download; OWID gains an owid_max_bytes bound (entities x years x row size, first_year for deep-history charts).
